title: Waf
description: kabuki: Web Application Firewall fingerprint detected for a target.

vendor.description: WAF vendor, e.g. Cloudflare, Akamai, AWS, F5.

product.description: Specific product or plan when known.

confidence.description: Detection confidence. Optional enum fields accept null.

detection_method.description: Primary signal used for the fingerprint.

evidence.description: Raw evidence (header value, cookie name, snippet).

blocked.description: Whether the WAF actively blocked the probe.

severity.description: Unified severity when reported as a finding.
